about: North Saanich is a district municipality at the tip of the Saanich Peninsula north of Victoria, British Columbia—not a city. Victoria International Airport, Swartz Bay ferry approaches, rural acreages, and shoreline parks share a quiet peninsula landscape beside Sidney. About 12,000 people live in North Saanich.
